certificate.heading: About your certificate of compliance
certificate.description1: Your certificate of compliance tells the environmental regulator whether you have met your recycling obligations for {{year}}.
certificate.description2: You must submit a certificate of compliance whether or not you have met your recycling obligations.
certificate.description3: You must submit your certificate to the regulator before or on 31 January every year.
certificate.warning: You may be subject to enforcement action if you do not submit your certificate of compliance on time.
certificate.howToDescription1: You must be an approved or delegated person to submit a certificate of compliance.
certificate.howToDescription2: On the next screen you will see a copy of your certificate for {{year}}. Before submitting it, you must:
certificate.bullet1: check that the details are correct
certificate.regulatorPrefix: If any details are incorrect, contact your environmental regulator:
certificate.downloadDescription: You will be able to download or print your certificate after submission.
certificate.alreadySubmittedLead: You have already submitted your certificate of compliance for {{year}}.

certificateSubmit.tonnesNote: All values are shown in whole tonnes.
certificateSubmit.declarationIntro: By entering your name and submitting this certificate of compliance, you are verifying:
certificateSubmit.declarationBullet1: you are an approved or delegated person who is eligible to submit this certificate of compliance on behalf of {{organisationName}}

statement.heading: About your statement of compliance
statement.description1Prefix: Your statement of compliance tells the environmental regulator whether, in the past year, you have met the requirements in
statement.description1Suffix: of the Producer Responsibility Regulations (Packaging and Packaging Waste) Regulations 2024.
statement.bullet1: registering producers who are members of your compliance scheme
statement.description2: You must submit a statement of compliance whether or not you have complied with the requirements of regulation 43.
statement.description3: You must submit the statement to the environmental regulator before or on 31 January every year.
statement.warning: You may be subject to enforcement action if you do not submit your statement of compliance on time.
statement.howToDescription1: You must be an approved or delegated person to submit the statement of compliance.
statement.howToDescription2: On the next screen, you will see a copy of your statement for {{year}}. Before submitting it, you must:
statement.regulatorPrefix: If any details are incorrect, contact your environmental regulator:
statement.downloadDescription: You will be able to download or print your statement after submission.
statement.continueUnavailableHint: Continuing to submit your statement is not available yet.
